4. INSTALL ROOF HEADLINING

REMOVABLE ROOF DISASSEMBLY AND

(a) Roof side rail weatherstrip

(c) Roof headlining
(d) Removable roof lock

(a) Bracket No.2
(b) Removable roof lock
(c) Roof headlining
(d) Removable roof moulding
